up: Retrieve compound identifiers and canonical SMILES for molecules tested in human assays targeting the human Orexin/Hypocretin receptor type 1 (CHEMBL5113). Include compounds with a chembl_id and canonical SMILES from compound_structures. Ensure assays are on the human organism and target the specific receptor CHEMBL5113. No additional filters (e.g., standard units, activity types, or date ranges).
sql: WITH target_assays AS (SELECT a.assay_id FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5113' AND ass.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens') SELECT DISTINCT cs.canonical_smiles, md.chembl_id FROM activities a JOIN target_assays ta ON a.assay_id = ta.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molecule_chembl_id = md.molecule_chembl_id JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molecule_chembl_id = cs.molecule_chembl_id WHERE md.chembl_id IS NOT NULL AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL

The result set should list each qualifying compound once, even if it appears in multiple assay rows.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molecule_chembl_id = cs.molecule_chembl_id WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5113' AND ass.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens'
